_help: Brands and rights holders shown with logos on the site. Key = the slug used in profile.html?id=. name = how it's written in deal names (brand or property side of 'Brand × Property'). domain = official website, used to fetch the logo from Brandfetch (needs site.brandfetch in deals.json). logo = optional path to a logo file in assets/logos/ that overrides Brandfetch. aliases = other names the same organisation appears under. Anything not listed still gets a page and a monogram. leagues = the club strips on the archive, in order. cat = industry category for brands; ptype = property type (Club & team, National team, League & competition, Event, Governing body, Athlete & talent, Venue, Other). Both are used by the Brands, Properties and Categories pages; tools/enrich.py fills them for new names where it can.
